commands.name: airlock-accept
commands.description: Apply the transaction to the real worktree

commands.name: airlock-reject
commands.description: Discard the transaction without applying it

commands.name: airlock-abort
commands.description: Abort the in-flight transaction (discard without review)
commands.output: airlock: no open transaction; pending multi-turn mode cleared.

commands.name: airlock-cleanup
commands.description: List stale transaction workspaces (add "purge" to remove them)
commands.output: airlock: no stale workspaces (the open transaction, if any, is excluded).

commands.name: airlock-history
commands.description: Show recent transaction history for this repository

commands.name: airlock-mode
commands.description: Show or set this repository’s safety mode: strict, balanced, or permissive
commands.output: airlock: mode for /work/app: strict. Set with /airlock-mode strict|balanced|permissive.

commands.name: airlock-begin
commands.description: Opt into a multi-turn transaction; use “end” to open it for review
commands.output: airlock: multi-turn mode enabled for this repository. The next coding turn opens a transaction that remains active across turns; use /airlock-begin end to review it.

commands.name: airlock-rejected
commands.output: airlock: no retained rejected transactions for this repository.

commands.name: airlock-review
commands.description: Open the interactive transaction review pane
commands.output: airlock: no open transaction to review.

children: Airlock has no open transaction for this repository.
